'''Kabbura ''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] allied with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In the [[Network Access]] sector of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], he and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Damarus]] joined forces in order to maintain the integrity of the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] in the sector.

During the Cold War, the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] controlled the Holo-Net Network Access center and allied it with the Sith. However, the Network was hacked and Kabbura and Damarus sent a Sith to investigate who it was and kill him.<ref name="Hostile Takeover" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Equipment==
Like several Hutts who had to deal with technology, [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] as an example, Kabbura wore an eye piece that served as a [[Computer interface visor]] that hooked up on the right side of his head and covered his right eye.

==Physical description==
Kabbura, like most [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], had brown and tan skin and had orange-brown eyes. He also wore a [[computer interface visor]] that served him some use while maintaining the integrity of the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] in [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa's]] [[Network Access]] sector.
